choose.when: AND m.project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM theme.dev_masterplan_plot WHERE plot_key = #{key})

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.dev_masterplan m WHERE true ) AS "masterPlans", p.*, s.* FROM (SELECT count(*) AS "mpPlots", count(sp.plot_key) AS "mpPlotsLinked", count(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.construction_status = 'Constructed') AS "mpPlotsBuilt", round(coalesce(sum(x.total_gfa), 0), 0) AS "plannedGfa", coalesce(sum(x.total_residential_units), 0) AS "plannedUnits", round(coalesce(sum(x.residential_population), 0), 0) AS "plannedPopulation", coalesce(sum(x.hotel_rooms), 0) AS "plannedHotelRooms", round(coalesce(sum(x.plot_area_sqm), 0), 0) AS "mpPlotAreaSqm" FROM theme.dev_masterplan_plot x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_plot sp ON sp.plot_key = x.plot_key WHERE true ) p, (SELECT count(*) AS "sites", coalesce(sum(x.buildings), 0) AS "siteBuildings", round(coalesce(sum(x.area_sqm), 0), 0) AS "siteAreaSqm" FROM theme.dev_construction_site x WHERE true ) s
SELECT coalesce(m.stage, 'Other') AS "k", count(*) AS "n" FROM theme.dev_masterplan m WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT v.k AS "k", round(sum(v.g), 0) AS "gfa" FROM theme.dev_masterplan_plot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Residential', x.residential_gfa), ('Office', x.office_gfa), ('Retail', x.retail_gfa), ('Hotel', x.hotel_gfa), ('Industrial', x.industrial_gfa), ('Commercial recreation', x.commercial_recreation_gfa), ('Religious', x.religious_gfa), ('Education', x.education_gfa), ('Healthcare', x.healthcare_gfa), ('Community facilities', x.community_facilities_gfa)) v(k, g) WHERE v.g > 0 GROUP BY v.k ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT m.project_id AS "projectId", m.project_no AS "projectNo", m.project_name AS "name", m.stage AS "stage", m.stage_raw AS "stageRaw", m.approval_year AS "approvalYear", m.developer_name AS "developer", m.masterplan_level AS "level", round(m.area_sqm, 0) AS "areaSqm", m.district_key AS "districtKey", m.community_key AS "communityKey", ST_X(m.centroid) AS "cx", ST_Y(m.centroid) AS "cy", k.plots AS "plots", k.built AS "plotsBuilt", k.gfa AS "plannedGfa", k.units AS "plannedUnits" FROM theme.dev_masterplan m LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS plots, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.construction_status = 'Constructed') AS built, round(sum(x.total_gfa), 0) AS gfa, sum(x.total_residential_units) AS units FROM theme.dev_masterplan_plot x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_plot sp ON sp.plot_key = x.plot_key WHERE x.project_id = m.project_id ) k ON true WHERE true ORDER BY m.area_sqm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.site_id AS "siteId", x.description AS "description", round(x.area_sqm, 0) AS "areaSqm", x.buildings AS "buildings", x.plot_key AS "plotKey", x.community_key AS "communityKey", ST_X(x.centroid) AS "cx", ST_Y(x.centroid) AS "cy" FROM theme.dev_construction_site x WHERE true ORDER BY x.area_sqm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.project_id AS "projectId", m.project_name AS "projectName", m.stage AS "stage", x.masterplan_type AS "masterplanType", x.approval_status AS "approvalStatus", x.registered_land_use AS "registeredLandUse", x.land_use_l1 AS "landUseL1", x.land_use_l2 AS "landUseL2", x.udm_plot_number AS "plotNumber", round(x.plot_area_sqm, 1) AS "plotAreaSqm", x.far AS "far", x.building_storeys AS "storeys", x.buildings AS "buildings", x.total_residential_units AS "units", round(x.residential_population, 0) AS "population", round(x.total_gfa, 0) AS "totalGfa", round(x.residential_gfa, 0) AS "residentialGfa", round(x.office_gfa, 0) AS "officeGfa", round(x.retail_gfa, 0) AS "retailGfa", round(x.hotel_gfa, 0) AS "hotelGfa" FROM theme.dev_masterplan_plot x LEFT JOIN theme.dev_masterplan m ON m.project_id = x.project_id WHERE x.plot_key = #{plotKey} ORDER BY x.total_gfa DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
